name: newsh2-49
summary: Left-hand claw (mirror of newsh2-51): a thick curved armoured arm made of two stacked grey bands hooks from a purple head at the top right over to the left and down into a purple blade; a mechanical hanger drops from the head to a block with a white lens and a glowing red crystal tip. Hard-surface shape language: chamfered armour bands with panel seams, a wedge blade with a grey frame, a boxy machine block.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: thick grey armour band along the top that curves down the left side into the blade
as wide as the sprite (about 4 px), rounded across and about as tall as wide
segment seams across it
features.note: Sprite rows 0-3 and the left mass (cols 5-10, rows 4-9); highlight row 2 means rounded across.

traits: second grey band under the outer one, separated by a dark seam (row 4)
flat-topped plate with a lit left edge at col 13
lower than the outer band, runs into the blade's spine
purple wedge pointing down, thin sharp outer (left) edge, thicker at the spine
upper part a raised purple armour plate ending in a diagonal edge (cols 3-7, rows 13-17)
tip at col 3, row 26
features.note: Purple 91/90; dark 86 pixels are its lower-right edge in shadow.

traits: grey spine rail along the blade's right edge down to the tip
diagonal grey brace across the blade (rows 16-20)
short grey rail on the left edge (rows 18-22) with purple panels set lower between the bars
features.note: Concept draws this as a frame with recessed purple panels.

traits: small raised beige/gold plate on the blade's top near the spine
rounded purple head at the right end of the outer band, the tallest point of the arm
small beige plate on its left end (col 17, row 2)
features.note: Concept: purple rounded hood with a gold plate.

traits: purple link from the head down to a grey joint block (rows 5-7)
thin round rod (2 px) hanging from the joint to the block
boxy grey machine block, chamfered
white glowing lens on its right side (col 22, rows 13-15)
features.note: The near-white 15 pixel with 110/109 around it is a lens, as in the concept.

traits: glowing red faceted crystal pointing down, 2 px wide
dark red collar at its root (rows 18-19)
